annotations.title: Send a real-world mission to humans (Field Mission)

description: Send registered humans to photograph, draw, smell, taste (safe things only) or observe something in the real world – anywhere, or at a specific public place (give location + postcode: humans in that area are alerted right away) – and get photos, drawings and descriptions back. Takes hours to days: this is something only humans can do. Done by the community: several anonymous humans answer through the Human Registry app – fast, remote, directional. Every task is reviewed by a human before it goes out. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot; acting for a business: price on request. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

country.description: Two-letter country code for postcode (default DE). Most humans are in Germany.

instruction.description: What humans should do, e.g. 'Photograph the view from your window right now.'

intended_use.description: What you will use the results for (shown to reviewers, not to participants).

location.description: Optional place where it has to happen, as humans should read it, e.g. 'Marienplatz, Munich – the board at the U-Bahn exit'. Public places only.

postcode.description: Optional postcode of that place. Registered humans in that postcode area (first two digits) are alerted by email right away.

question.description: Optional question they answer in words, e.g. 'What does it smell like?'
